row.notes: Out {u16,has}: settings 0x140d82070 must be valid, key top16 != 0x3fff; finds driver row in [[this+0x278]+0x2e0..+0x2e8] (0x88 stride, +0x52/+0x50); rating = 0x14113d120([this+0x360]); flag = 0x140d822a0 (no +0x4b&0x10) or rating <= days-[this+0x2d0]; band 0x200 if rating >= thr1, 0x100 if >= thr2; out = flag|band. Not a cached overall rating. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Career_DriverMarket_GetDriverRatingBand (bound record keeps its name).
